        triton.Config({'BLOCK_COL': 64,  'BLOCK_RED': 8},  num_warps=16, num_stages=2),

        triton.Config({'BLOCK_COL': 128, 'BLOCK_RED': 16}, num_warps=16, num_stages=2),
        triton.Config({'BLOCK_COL': 256, 'BLOCK_RED': 4},  num_warps=32, num_stages=2),
        triton.Config({'BLOCK_COL': 256, 'BLOCK_RED': 8},  num_warps=32, num_stages=2),
